incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: elevated 5xx rate on gateway (us-west-2). Alerting oncall. Summary: 5xx spike started ~2026-03-10T22:07Z, affects /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. P95 latency increased. Paging jen-oconnor.

jen-oconnor: taking pager. on it. any immediate mitigation suggestions?

sam-lee: seeing 5xx jump to ~11.8% across the gateway cluster starting 22:07 UTC. Error breakdown: 502 (gateway), 504 (upstream timeout), 503 (overloaded). Top clients: a few high-QPS SaaS tenants. SLO breach for chat streaming.

alex-mendez: adding quick correlation sample from request logs (stripped for PII). these requests all share the same trace pattern; looks like retries piling up.

alex-mendez: ```
2026-03-10T22:07:13.482Z  request_id=cid-8a3f1a trace_id=8a3f1a.. status=502 upstream_status=504 retry_count=3 route=/v1/chat/stream backend=runtime-prod-1 zone=us-west-2
2026-03-10T22:07:13.990Z  request_id=cid-8a3f1b trace_id=8a3f1b.. status=502 upstream_status=504 retry_count=2 route=/v1/generate backend=quantized-rt-2
2026-03-10T22:07:14.250Z  request_id=cid-8a3f1c trace_id=8a3f1c.. status=503 upstream_status=503 retry_count=4 route=/v1/generate backend=cached-rt-3
```

alex-mendez: Trace links: https://observability.internal/traces/8a3f1a.. (quick look shows long tail on backend latency ~ 6-8s)

jen-oconnor: hypothesis: retry amplification between gateway and downstream runtime + backend slow responses -> queueing -> 5xx. quick mitigations: reduce gateway retry count to 0, enable circuit-breaker on overloaded backends, and divert a small % of traffic to a warm fallback pool.

sam-lee: I can flip retries down at the gateway. proposing: set envoy max_retries: 0 and reduce per-try timeout to 3s while we triage.

jen-oconnor: do it. also scale runtime-prod to reduce queueing. alex, can you prepare list of high-QPS tenants so CS can notify?

opsbot: @sam-lee requested change: env set ENVOY_MAX_RETRIES=0 in configmap gateway-config. applying...

opsbot: deploy-bot: rollout/gateway-config updated (sha: a1b2c3) -> gateway pods restarting behind LB.

sam-lee: confirmed envoy config applied. initial metrics show 5xx dropping to ~6% after 45s. still above baseline but trending down.

murali-r: adding observation: backend runtime pods show high context-switches and goroutine waits, GC spikes not obvious. possible head-of-line due to long KV-cache miss or disk I/O blocking in quantized kernel. also saw increased S3 latency for model artifacts during the window.

alex-mendez: pulling more detailed request ids for RCA. sample of correlation ids to trace full path: [cid-8a3f1a, cid-8a3f1b, cid-8a3f1c, cid-8a3f20, cid-8a3f2a]. storing in incident timeline doc.

jen-oconnor: mitigation status: 1) gateway retries -> 0 (done). 2) scaled runtime-prod from 4 -> 8 pods (kubectl output below). 3) temporarily removed canary routing for quantized-rt-2 (diverted to stable).

jen-oconnor: ```
$ kubectl -n inference scale deploy runtime-prod --replicas=8
deployment.apps/runtime-prod scaled
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime-prod -o wide
NAME                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
runtime-prod-56f7c      1/1     Running   0          2m
runtime-prod-67a3b      1/1     Running   0          1m
```

eve_security: tagging security/incident notebook. any indication of malicious traffic? looks like legitimate tenant patterns, not prod attack.

customer-success: gathering impacted tenant list from usage logs now. draft message prepared for affected customers once we have confirmed list.

sam-lee: after scaling + retry-disable, 5xx is now ~2.3% and p95 latency back to normal for most routes. still seeing sporadic 504s from a subset of backend pods.

alex-mendez: deep trace for cid-8a3f1a shows upstream runtime returned 504 after internal queue wait of 4.9s; runtime logs show a spike in model load time due to cache eviction event at 22:06:58 UTC.

alex-mendez: ```
2026-03-10T22:06:58.102Z runtime-prod-56f7c INFO cache_eviction model=vision-xl reason=mem-pressure
2026-03-10T22:06:59.210Z runtime-prod-56f7c INFO model_load_start model=vision-xl src=S3
2026-03-10T22:07:03.512Z runtime-prod-56f7c INFO model_load_done model=vision-xl duration=4.3s
```

murali-r: that matches S3 latency spikes I saw (~>2s per model chunk). hypothesis refined: S3 artifact latency caused model loads to block runtime threads; combined with upstream retries created cascading failures.

jen-oconnor: agreed. action items during incident: 1) keep retries disabled at gateway for 2h. 2) provision a warm cache for popular models (short-term: pre-warm vision-xl on extra replicas). 3) ops to investigate S3 region performance and fallback config. 4) CS to notify impacted tenants with template.

customer-success: sending draft to impacted tenants now (list attached in timeline doc). will hold for final confirmation.

sam-lee: monitoring post-prewarm: error rate steady at ~1.1%, within SLO for now. p95 recovered.
